about: Pictures of the Made for Groddle section composed by tools/made-art/compose.py from shipped files and three game screenshots; tools/made-art/build-data.mjs checks each against its sha256.

public/assets/made-art/ezc-props-outline.what: Our drawing of EZ Cookin's table, counter and lamp, at their measured sizes
public/assets/made-art/ezc-props-outline.made: drawn by compose.py from the outlines of research/art-briefs/ez-cookin/attach/01-measurements-ours.svg (our own measurement drawing) at their measured sizes, lamp, counter and table one above the other 24 units apart, 3 px a unit

public/assets/made-art/ezc-props.webp.what: EZ Cookin's made table, counter and lamp, at the sizes the street draws them
public/assets/made-art/ezc-props.webp.made: the three made decos (3x files) at the sizes the street draws them (js/practice-streets.js EZ_PROP_ART), placed as in the drawing beside it, 3 px a unit, on the same paper

public/assets/made-art/ezc-room-stand-in.what: Breezy, EZ Cookin' with Tiny Speck's stand-ins: store_counter, store_lamp_01, k04_table_01 (CC0)
public/assets/made-art/ezc-room-stand-in.made: screenshot of the game (1280 x 800, deviceScaleFactor 2): the tutorial's EZ Cooking pick (?newxp=skill&newxpskill=ezcooking_1, Aiight), the avatar placed at x 1640, the street JSON of 51a268aa9d^ served in place of today's; the HUD cropped off (x 232-1220, y 60-640), Lanczos to 720 x 423

public/assets/made-art/ezc-room.webp.what: Breezy, EZ Cookin' with its made counters and lamps
public/assets/made-art/ezc-room.webp.made: screenshot of the game (1280 x 800, deviceScaleFactor 2): the tutorial's EZ Cooking pick (?newxp=skill&newxpskill=ezcooking_1, Aiight), the avatar placed at x 1640, today's street; the HUD cropped off (x 232-1220, y 60-640), Lanczos to 720 x 423

public/assets/made-art/maps-painted.webp.what: The paintings of Ix, Uralia and Haoma made again for Groddle
public/assets/made-art/maps-painted.webp.made: the three repainted maps (2x files) at four times the thumbnails, one above the other, 12 px apart (tools/provenance/repainted-maps.json)

public/assets/made-art/maps-thumbs.webp.what: Tiny Speck's thumbnails of Ix, Uralia and Haoma
public/assets/made-art/maps-thumbs.webp.made: the three CC0 thumbnails as they are, one above the other, 3 px apart

public/assets/made-art/subway-map-paper-.what: The recreated Subway System paper with the Red Line and its stations drawn on it
public/assets/made-art/subway-map-paper-.made: screenshot of js/map-views.js renderSubwayMapSvg (the Map's Subway view) at 760 x 460, deviceScaleFactor 2, on the game's style.css with the station names and line buttons hidden; the rounded corners cropped (8 px), Lanczos to 752 x 452

public/assets/made-art/subway-sign-map.w.what: The little map on Tiny Speck's in-world Subway Map sign
public/assets/made-art/subway-sign-map.w.made: crop x 27-259, y 47-205 of the sign (its map panel), lossless
